purpose: Combine successful original GW history-slice artifacts with only the exact-state repaired missing slices into one complete O0/O2-identical P3 groundwater Reference route set.
binding_requirements: The original GW repair run must be terminal.
Its only scientifically admissible missing cases must be explicitly bound as verified exit-143 technical interruptions.
The missing-slice repair run must complete successfully.
Successful original slices must be used unchanged and must not be rerun or replaced.
Repaired slices may only fill cases listed in the missing-slice repair binding.
The consolidated O0 and O2 complete route traces must be identical for each material and route.
